## More Papers

#### [An Active Matter Pathway for Non-Equilibrium Liquid-Liquid Extractions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08978v1>)
*Jude C. Obijiaku, Oladipupo P. Ogolo, Damilola E. Fadipe, Angela Deneke, Karthik Nayani* <br>
Marangoni flows driven by metal-induced interfacial tension gradients accelerate ion transport across oil-water interfaces and enable rate-mediated selective separation through non-diffusive kinetics.

#### [Nuclear mechanics controls the temporal dynamics of cell unjamming](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07777v1>)
*Leon Hillmann, Quirine J. S. Braat, Pablo Gottheil, Eliane Blauth, Anne Marie Scholz, Kolya M. Lettl, Jürgen Lippoldt, Pieta C. M. Wielstra, Sibylle Hess, Mitko Veta, Josef A. Käs, Liesbeth M. C. Janssen* <br>
Explicitly modeling nuclear deformability reconciles density- and shape-driven theories by establishing a predictive relationship between nuclear morphology and tissue-scale rigidity transitions, a finding validated in breast cell monolayers.

#### [Active wetting/de-wetting of focal adhesions on viscoelastic substrates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03393v1>)
*Ivana Pajic-Lijakovic, Milan Milivojevic, Boris Martinac, Massimo Vassalli, Peter VE McClintock* <br>
Cell adhesion to viscoelastic substrates is mediated by focal adhesions (FAs), which dynamically couple actomyosin contractility to the extracellular matrix.

#### [Interface dynamics in tissue invasion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08735v1>)
*Nino Despeignes, Lila Sarfati, Marc Durand, Frédéric van Wijland* <br>
Homeostatic pressure differences generate an emergent capillary surface tension that stabilizes tissue boundaries, while active force imbalances shift propagation regimes and can trigger interfacial instability at high drives.

#### [A minimal physical model of cochlear mechanics: Insights into active nonlinear feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08096v1>)
*Vidyunmathi N. A., Toby Joseph* <br>
Exponential displacement-dependent feedback and longitudinal mechanical coupling replicate the level-dependent transition from active amplification to passive behavior and the resulting traveling-wave dynamics more accurately than cubic nonlinearities.

#### [Depletant-DNA Induces Chirality in the Condensed Domains of Lyotropic Liquid Crystals](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08970v1>)
*Zeba Afia Hasan, Elizabeth Adeogun, Harold Hatch, Jacob Monroe, Karthik Nayani* <br>
Nanomolar concentrations of genetic material drive the elongation of disodium cromoglycate aggregates and trigger an isotropic-to-biphasic phase transition, enabling a rapid optical signaling mechanism for diagnostic applications like PCR.

#### [Lag-induced critical transitions to extinction in replicating systems: the $τ$-tipping mechanism](<http://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/gyd9-ctnc>)
*Edward A. Turner, Francisco Crespo, Joan Gimeno, Ernest Fontich, Santiago F. Elena, and Josep Sardanyés* <br>
Environmental fluctuations drive population collapse by outpacing the adaptation of enzymatic replication rates, establishing a non-genetic pathway distinct from classical lethal mutagenesis.

#### [Two heads are better than one: Single stranded DNA translocation of UvrD-family dimers vs. monomers](<https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.08.07.743547v1>)
*Mersch, K. N.; Nguyen, B.; Kozlov, A. G.; Lohman, T. M.* <br>
Covalent crosslinking enables active, highly processive DNA unwinding at rates nearly equal to movement speeds, whereas individual subunits remain incapable of duplex separation.

#### [Intrinsically unidirectional stepwise chemically fueled rotary molecular motors](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-026-65399-3>)
*Zhang, Yu, Jia, Tianhao, Dong, Zheng, Yang, Yuhang, Ma, Xiaoqiang, Zhao, Depeng* <br>
Harnessing and rectifying random Brownian motion and achieving precise directional control at the molecular level remain major obstacles, making the development of chemically fueled molecular motors that operate with intrinsic directional control a significant challenge.

#### [Physics-informed digital twin and onboard control of a brainbot for intelligent active matter](<http://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/rd1t-h2v6>)
*I. Mammadli, P. Shrestha, J. Pande, F. Novkoski, S. Mohapatra, M. Noirhomme, A. Maier, N. Vandewalle, and A.-S. Smith* <br>
Programmable bristlebots integrate sensing and state anticipation to function as adaptive particles capable of autonomous navigation in nonequilibrium environments.

#### [Nonreversible gauge fields in Fokker-Planck dynamics: Supersymmetric Hamiltonians and learned finite forces](<http://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/tg4c-7cnr>)
*Masayuki Ohzeki* <br>
We formulate stationary-density-preserving nonreversible perturbations of Fokker-Planck dynamics as gauge fields that deform relaxation spectra while leaving the invariant state fixed.

*Cathelijne ter Burg and David Zwicker* <br>
Coupling between chemical fluxes through cross-diffusion or mechanical forces destabilizes static arrangements, resulting in the emergence of traveling waves and oscillatory behaviors.

#### [Permutation theory governs long-term dynamics of critical Boolean networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07790v1>)
*Venkata Sai Narayana Bavisetty, Matthew Wheeler, Julian Vignes, Matthew Stephen Jones, Ruodan Liu, Sean Campbell, Claus Kadelka* <br>
Feedback loops in $K=1$ systems induce permutations whose orders determine attractor lengths, resulting in a mean length of $\exp[N^{1/3}]$ that is driven by rare networks with exceptionally long cycles.

*Victor Lequin, Giulio Biroli, Camille Scalliet* <br>
Bistability, the existence of two alternative stable states with distinct basins of attraction, is common across ecology and many other biological, chemical, and physical systems.

*Sachin Shanbhag, Ralm G. Ricarte* <br>

*Davide Mandelli, Emiliano Ippoliti, Charles Plate* <br>
